rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns administrative fines and a 5% cross-compliance reduction (randvoorwaardenkorting) imposed under the Dutch Fertilizers Act (Meststoffenwet) for exceeding manure application standards (gebruiksnormen), failing to meet manure processing obligations (mestverwerkingsplichten), and falsifying Animal Manure Transport Documents (Vervoersbewijzen Dierlijke Meststoffen). Under the coding protocol, Dutch Meststoffenwet manure/fertilizer compliance disputes are explicitly NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
